Definition

The attempted k >= 3 dihedral symmetrization of Wohlgemuth's genus-3 handle surface. Its failure questions the folklore that a surface existing for some dihedral order k exists for all larger k.

Not yet built

This surface is catalogued but not yet built by the extension, so it has no mesh or thumbnail here.

Not transcribed. The record exists to state that the surface is absent and why; a fabricated equation would be worse than a null.
